# mlkem-native provenance

- Project: `pq-code-package/mlkem-native`
- Release: `v1.2.0`
- Commit: `0ba906cb14b1c241476134d7403a811b382ca498`
- Imported: 2026-07-13
- License selected by SwStack: MIT (see `LICENSE`)

Only the portable C source tree under upstream `mlkem/` is imported. Native
assembly backends, development scripts, benchmarks and test-only random-number
generators are intentionally excluded. The generated monolithic compilation
unit `mlkem_native.c` is compiled for ML-KEM-768 with randomized entry points
disabled. Entropy is generated by SwStack and passed to the deterministic
FIPS 203 APIs.
